measurement: Live task wall time, including BERT and per-turn D3/tool cleanup; model loading and warmup excluded. One execution per task/policy/repetition.
quality_scope: Existing fixed-user-message tau2 harness and ACTION reward. No official interactive tau2 success claim. Turn-cap hits reported explicitly.
timing_spork_scope: Native first-chunk launch strategy on the common exact-token transport; not a byte-for-byte replay of the legacy HTTP runner
failure_policy: Retain and seal failed completed attempts; never silently select a faster rerun. An interrupted, unsealed attempt is retained and restarted on resume.
